[Chat Options and Configuration | spring-projects/spring-ai | DeepWiki](https://deepwiki.com/spring-projects/spring-ai/2.5-chat-options-and-configuration)\n\n# Spring AI DeepSeekChatOptions extraBody and Thinking Mode\n\n## DeepSeek Thinking Mode Overview\n\nDeepSeek's thinking mode allows the model to output chain-of-thought reasoning before providing a final answer.[1] The thinking mode is controlled through the &#96;extra_body&#96; parameter when using OpenAI-compatible APIs.[1][4]\n\n## Using extraBody with Thinking\n\nTo enable thinking mode in DeepSeek, you pass a parameter within &#96;extra_body&#96;:[1]\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\nextra_body={\"thinking\": {\"type\": \"enabled\"}}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nYou can also disable it with:[4]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\nextra_body={\"thinking\": {\"type\": \"disabled\"}}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe reasoning output is returned separately in a &#96;reasoning_content&#96; field, while the final answer appears in the &#96;content&#96; field.[1][4]\n\n## Spring AI Support for extraBody\n\nSpring AI is working to support &#96;extra_body&#96; and related parameters (&#96;extra_headers&#96;, &#96;extra_query&#96;) in chat options to improve compatibility with OpenAI-compatible endpoints.[2] This enables passing arbitrary fields that aren't part of the official OpenAI API, such as experimental features or provider-specific options.[2]\n\nThe addition of &#96;extra_body&#96; support would allow Spring AI users to access features like DeepSeek's thinking mode and other model-specific parameters without requiring custom implementations.[2]",

The&#96;spring.ai.deepseek.chat.base-url&#96; and&#96;spring.ai.deepseek.chat.api-key&#96; properties, if set, take precedence over the common properties. This is useful if you want to use different DeepSeek accounts for different models and different model endpoints. |\n| --- |\n\n| All properties prefixed with&#96;spring.ai.deepseek.chat.options&#96; can be overridden at runtime by adding a request-specific Runtime Options to the&#96;Prompt&#96; call. |\n| --- |\n\n## Runtime Options\n\nThe [DeepSeekChatOptions.java](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-ai/blob/main/models/spring-ai-deepseek/src/main/java/org/springframework/ai/deepseek/DeepSeekChatOptions.java) provides model configurations, such as the model to use, the temperature, the frequency penalty, etc.\n\nOn startup, the default options can be configured with the&#96;DeepSeekChatModel(api, options)&#96; constructor or the&#96;spring.ai.deepseek.chat.options.*&#96; properties.\n\nAt runtime, you can override the default options by adding new, request-specific options to the&#96;Prompt&#96; call. For example, to override the default model and temperature for a specific request:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nChatResponse response = chatModel.call(\n    new Prompt(\n        \"Generate the names of 5 famous pirates. Please provide the JSON response without any code block markers such as &#96;&#96;&#96;json&#96;&#96;&#96;.\",\n        DeepSeekChatOptions.builder()\n            .withModel(DeepSeekApi.ChatModel.DEEPSEEK_CHAT.getValue())\n            .withTemperature(0.8f)\n        .build()\n    ));\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n| In addition to the model-specific [DeepSeekChatOptions](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-ai/blob/main/models/spring-ai-deepseek/src/main/java/org/springframework/ai/deepseek/DeepSeekChatOptions.java), you can use a portable [ChatOptions](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-ai/blob/main/spring-ai-model/src/main/java/org/springframework/ai/chat/prompt/ChatOptions.java) instance, created with the [ChatOptions#builder()](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-ai/blob/main/spring-ai-model/src/main/java/org/springframework/ai/chat/prompt/DefaultChatOptionsBuilder.java). |\n| --- |\n\n## Sample Controller (Auto-configuration)\n\n[Create](https://start.spring.io/) a new Spring Boot project and add the&#96;spring-ai-starter-model-deepseek&#96; to your pom (or gradle) dependencies.\n\nAdd an&#96;application.properties&#96; file under the&#96;src/main/resources&#96; directory to enable and configure the DeepSeek Chat model:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nspring.ai.deepseek.api-key=YOUR_API_KEY\nspring.ai.deepseek.chat.options.model=deepseek-chat\nspring.ai.deepseek.chat.options.temperature=0.8\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n| Replace the&#96;api-key&#96; with your DeepSeek credentials. |\n| --- |\n\nThis will create a&#96;DeepSeekChatModel&#96; implementation that you can inject into your class. Here is an example of a simple&#96;@Controller&#96; class that uses the chat model for text generation.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n@RestController\npublic class ChatController {\n\n    private final DeepSeekChatModel chatModel;\n\n    @Autowired\n    public ChatController(DeepSeekChatModel chatModel) {\n        this.chatModel = chatModel;\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/ai/generate\")\n    public Map generate(@RequestParam(value = \"message\", defaultValue = \"Tell me a joke\") String message) {\n        return Map.of(\"generation\", chatModel.call(message));\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/ai/generateStream\")\n\tpublic Flux\u003cChatResponse\u003e generateStream(@RequestParam(value = \"message\", defaultValue = \"Tell me a joke\") String message) {\n        var prompt = new Prompt(new UserMessage(message));\n        return chatModel.stream(prompt);\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Chat Prefix Completion\n\nThe chat prefix completion follows the Chat Completion API, where users provide an assistant’s prefix message for the model to complete the rest of the message.\n\nWhen using prefix completion, the user must ensure that the last message in the messages list is a DeepSeekAssistantMessage.\n\nBelow is a complete Java code example for chat prefix completion. In this example, we set the prefix message of the assistant to \"&#96;&#96;&#96;python\\n\" to force the model to output Python code, and set the stop parameter to [‘&#96;’] to prevent additional explanations from the model.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n@RestController\npublic class CodeGenerateController {\n\n    private final DeepSeekChatModel chatModel;\n\n    @Autowired\n    public ChatController(DeepSeekChatModel chatModel) {\n        this.chatModel = chatModel;\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/ai/generatePythonCode\")\n    public String generate(@RequestParam(value = \"message\", defaultValue = \"Please write quick sort code\") String message) {\n\t\tUserMessage userMessage = new UserMessage(message);\n\t\tMessage assistantMessage = DeepSeekAssistantMessage.prefixAssistantMessage(\"&#96;&#96;&#96;python\\\\n\");\n\t\tPrompt prompt = new Prompt(List.of(userMessage, assistantMessage), ChatOptions.builder().stopSequences(List.of(\"&#96;&#96;&#96;\")).build());\n\t\tChatResponse response = chatModel.call(prompt);\n\t\treturn response.getResult().getOutput().getText();\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Reasoning Model (deepseek-reasoner)\n\nThe&#96;deepseek-reasoner&#96; is a reasoning model developed by DeepSeek. Before delivering the final answer, the model first generates a Chain of Thought (CoT) to enhance the accuracy of its responses. Our API provides users with access to the CoT content generated by&#96;deepseek-reasoner&#96;, enabling them to view, display, and distill it.\n\nYou can use the&#96;DeepSeekAssistantMessage&#96; to get the CoT content generated by&#96;deepseek-reasoner&#96;.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\npublic void deepSeekReasonerExample() {\n    DeepSeekChatOptions promptOptions = DeepSeekChatOptions.builder()\n            .model(DeepSeekApi.ChatModel.DEEPSEEK_REASONER.getValue())\n            .build();\n    Prompt prompt = new Prompt(\"9.11 and 9.8, which is greater?\", promptOptions);\n    ChatResponse response = chatModel.call(prompt);\n\n    // Get the CoT content generated by deepseek-reasoner, only available when using deepseek-reasoner model\n    DeepSeekAssistantMessage deepSeekAssistantMessage = (DeepSeekAssistantMessage) response.getResult().getOutput();\n    String reasoningContent = deepSeekAssistantMessage.getReasoningContent();\n    String text = deepSeekAssistantMessage.getText();\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Reasoning Model Multi-round Conversation\n\nIn each round of the conversation, the model outputs the CoT (reasoning_content) and the final answer (content). In the next round of the conversation, the CoT from previous rounds is not concatenated into the context, as illustrated in the following diagram:\n\nPlease note that if the reasoning_content field is included in the sequence of input messages, the API will return a 400 error. Therefore, you should remove the reasoning_content field from the API response before making the API request, as demonstrated in the API example.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\npublic String deepSeekReasonerMultiRoundExample() {\n    List\u003cMessage\u003e messages = new ArrayList\u003c\u003e();\n    messages.add(new UserMessage(\"9.11 and 9.8, which is greater?\"));\n    DeepSeekChatOptions promptOptions = DeepSeekChatOptions.builder()\n            .model(DeepSeekApi.ChatModel.DEEPSEEK_REASONER.getValue())\n            .build();\n\n    Prompt prompt = new Prompt(messages, promptOptions);\n    ChatResponse response = chatModel.call(prompt);\n\n    DeepSeekAssistantMessage deepSeekAssistantMessage = (DeepSeekAssistantMessage) response.getResult().getOutput();\n    String reasoningContent = deepSeekAssistantMessage.getReasoningContent();\n    String text = deepSeekAssistantMessage.getText();\n\n    messages.add(AssistantMessage.builder().content(Objects.requireNonNull(text)).build());\n    messages.add(new UserMessage(\"How many Rs are there in the word 'strawberry'?\"));\n    Prompt prompt2 = new Prompt(messages, promptOptions);\n    ChatResponse response2 = chatModel.call(prompt2);\n\n    DeepSeekAssistantMessage deepSeekAssistantMessage2 = (DeepSeekAssistantMessage) response2.getResult().getOutput();\n    String reasoningContent2 = deepSeekAssistantMessage2.getReasoningContent();\n    return deepSeekAssistantMessage2.getText();\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Manual Configuration\n\nThe [DeepSeekChatModel](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-ai/blob/main/models/spring-ai-deepseek/src/main/java/org/springframework/ai/deepseek/DeepSeekChatModel.java) implements the&#96;ChatModel&#96; and&#96;StreamingChatModel&#96; and uses the Low-level DeepSeekApi Client to connect to the DeepSeek service.\n\nAdd the&#96;spring-ai-deepseek&#96; dependency to your project’s Maven&#96;pom.xml&#96; file:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\u003cdependency\u003e\n    \u003cgroupId\u003eorg.springframework.ai\u003c/groupId\u003e\n    \u003cartifactId\u003espring-ai-deepseek\u003c/artifactId\u003e\n\u003c/dependency\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nor to your Gradle&#96;build.gradle&#96; file.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\ndependencies {\n    implementation 'org.springframework.ai:spring-ai-deepseek'\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n| Refer to the [Dependency Management](https://docs.spring.io/spring-ai/reference/getting-started.html#dependency-management) section to add the Spring AI BOM to your build file. |\n| --- |\n\nNext, create a&#96;DeepSeekChatModel&#96; and use it for text generation:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nDeepSeekApi deepSeekApi = DeepSeekApi.builder()\n        .apiKey(System.getenv(\"DEEPSEEK_API_KEY\"))\n        .build();\nDeepSeekChatOptions options = DeepSeekChatOptions.builder()\n        .model(DeepSeekApi.ChatModel.DEEPSEEK_CHAT.getValue())\n        .temperature(0.4)\n        .maxTokens(200)\n        .build();\nDeepSeekChatModel chatModel = DeepSeekChatModel.builder()\n        .deepSeekApi(deepSeekApi)\n        .defaultOptions(options)\n        .build();\nChatResponse response = chatModel.call(\n    new Prompt(\"Generate the names of 5 famous pirates.\"));\n\n// Or with streaming responses\nFlux\u003cChatResponse\u003e streamResponse = chatModel.stream(\n    new Prompt(\"Generate the names of 5 famous pirates.\"));\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe&#96;DeepSeekChatOptions&#96; provides the configuration information for the chat requests. The&#96;DeepSeekChatOptions.Builder&#96; is a fluent options builder.\n\n### Low-level DeepSeekApi Client\n\nThe [DeepSeekApi](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-ai/blob/main/models/spring-ai-deepseek/src/main/java/org/springframework/ai/deepseek/api/DeepSeekApi.java) is a lightweight Java client for [DeepSeek API](https://platform.deepseek.com/api-docs/).\n\nHere is a simple snippet showing how to use the API programmatically:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nDeepSeekApi deepSeekApi =\n    new DeepSeekApi(System.getenv(\"DEEPSEEK_API_KEY\"));\n\nChatCompletionMessage chatCompletionMessage =\n    new ChatCompletionMessage(\"Hello world\", Role.USER);\n\n// Sync request\nResponseEntity\u003cChatCompletion\u003e response = deepSeekApi.chatCompletionEntity(\n    new ChatCompletionRequest(List.of(chatCompletionMessage), DeepSeekApi.ChatModel.DEEPSEEK_CHAT.getValue(), 0.7, false));\n\n// Streaming request\nFlux\u003cChatCompletionChunk\u003e streamResponse = deepSeekApi.chatCompletionStream(\n    new ChatCompletionRequest(List.of(chatCompletionMessage), DeepSeekApi.ChatModel.DEEPSEEK_CHAT.getValue(), 0.7, true));\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nFollow the [DeepSeekApi.java](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-ai/blob/main/models/spring-ai-deepseek/src/main/java/org/springframework/ai/deepseek/api/DeepSeekApi.java)'s JavaDoc for further information.\n\n#### DeepSeekApi Samples\n\nThe [DeepSeekApiIT.java](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-ai/blob/main/models/spring-ai-deepseek/src/test/java/org/springframework/ai/deepseek/api/DeepSeekApiIT.java) test provides some general examples of how to use the lightweight library.",

}

So Spring AI OpenAI client supports:

Spring AI OpenAI client supports `extraBody` with nested thinking maps and `reasoningEffort` configuration through `spring.ai.openai.chat.options.extra-body`. The project uses `spring-ai-starter-model-deepseek` with the `deepseek-4-pro` model, which requires an OpenAI-compatible API with `extra_body` for thinking mode. The recommended approach is to switch to `spring-ai-starter-model-openai` with DeepSeek's base URL or use the OpenAI SDK as suggested by DeepSeek's official documentation.

The Spring AI DeepSeek starter likely does not support thinking mode for the deepseek-v4-pro model without `extra_body` configuration. To enable thinking mode, switch to the OpenAI starter with DeepSeek's base URL set to `https://api.deepseek.com`.

The plan involves:
1. Switching the dependency from deepseek to openai starter, or adding the openai starter alongside the existing deepseek starter.
2. Updating `application.yml` to configure `spring.ai.openai` with DeepSeek's base URL and setting the model to `deepseek-v4-pro`.
3. Configuring thinking mode either in `AiClientConfig` or `application.yml`.

Revisiting `application.yml`, it currently uses:
```yaml
spring:
 ai:
  deepseek:
```

The YAML structure for nested `extra-body` thinking in Spring Boot should use dot notation: `spring.ai.openai.chat.options.extra-body.thinking.type: enabled`. Alternatively, in Java, it can be configured as `.extraBody(Map.of("thinking", Map.of("type", "enabled")))`.

Update `AiClientConfig` to set default options on the `ChatClient` builder, including `reasoningEffort` and `extraBody` for thinking mode. Note that temperature is not supported when thinking mode is enabled. Verify Spring Boot property binding for nested `extra-body` and `reasoning-effort` in `application.yml`. _**Agent (composer-2.5)**_

已按 DeepSeek [Thinking Mode](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/thinking_mode) 文档完成配置。要点如下。

## 原因

`deepseek-v4-pro` 的 thinking 模式需通过 **OpenAI 兼容 API** 传入：

- `reasoning_effort: "high"`
- `extra_body: {"thinking": {"type": "enabled"}}`

Spring AI 的 `DeepSeekChatOptions` **不支持** `extraBody`，只有 `OpenAiChatOptions` 支持（Spring AI 1.1.6 会将 `extraBody` 展平到请求 JSON 顶层，与 Python SDK 行为一致）。

## 改动

1. **`pom.xml`**：`spring-ai-starter-model-deepseek` → `spring-ai-starter-model-openai`

2. **`application.yml`**：改为 OpenAI 兼容配置，指向 DeepSeek API：

```yaml
spring.ai.openai:
  api-key: ${DEEPSEEK_API_KEY:${OPENAI_API_KEY:}}
  base-url: https://api.deepseek.com
  chat.options.model: deepseek-v4-pro
```

3. **`AiClientConfig.java`**：在 `ChatClient` 上设置默认 thinking 选项（等价于 Python 示例）：

```java
OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
    .reasoningEffort("high")
    .extraBody(Map.of("thinking", Map.of("type", "enabled")))
    .build()
```

`TicketRoutingApplicationService` 注入的 `structuredOutputChatClient` 会自动带上上述参数，**53–57 行无需修改**。

## 等价写法（若只想单次调用启用）

```java
TicketRoutingDecision decision = chatClient.prompt()
    .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
        .reasoningEffort("high")
        .extraBody(Map.of("thinking", Map.of("type", "enabled")))
        .build())
    .system(promptFactory.systemPrompt())
    .user(promptFactory.userPrompt(command))
    .call()
    .entity(TicketRoutingDecision.class);
```

## 注意

- Thinking 模式下 `temperature` / `top_p` 等参数**无效**（已移除原先的 `temperature: 0.1`）。
- 请设置环境变量 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`（或 `OPENAI_API_KEY`）。
- 推理过程在响应 metadata 的 `reasoningContent` 中；结构化输出仍使用 `content` 字段。

请在本机执行 `mvn compile -pl ruoyi-modules/ai-structured -am` 验证（当前仓库 `ruoyi-common-core` 存在与本次改动无关的编译问题）。

        .reasoningEffort("high")
        .extraBody(Map.of("thinking", Map.of("type", "enabled")))
        .build()) 也可以吧？

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Confirmed. The ChatOptions interface does not include getExtraBody() or getReasoningEffort().</details></think>

_**Agent (composer-2.5)**_

**不可以。** 在 `spring-ai-starter-model-deepseek` 下写 `.options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()...)`，**`reasoningEffort` 和 `extraBody` 不会进 HTTP 请求**，thinking 模式不会真正开启。

## 原因（Spring AI 1.1.6 源码行为）

`DeepSeekChatModel.buildRequestPrompt()` 会把运行时 options 转成 `DeepSeekChatOptions`：

```java
runtimeOptions = ModelOptionsUtils.copyToTarget(
    prompt.getOptions(), ChatOptions.class, DeepSeekChatOptions.class);
```

`copyToTarget` 只复制 **`ChatOptions` 接口**上的字段（model、temperature、maxTokens 等）。  
`OpenAiChatOptions` 里的 `extraBody`、`reasoningEffort` **不在** `ChatOptions` 接口里，这一步会被**静默丢弃**。

随后 `createRequest()` 用 `ModelOptionsUtils.merge` 把 options 合并进 `DeepSeekApi.ChatCompletionRequest`，而该 record 只有 `model`、`temperature`、`max_tokens` 等字段，**没有** `thinking`、`reasoning_effort`、`extra_body`。

因此即使用 DeepSeek starter + `OpenAiChatOptions`，请求体里也不会出现：

```json
{
  "reasoning_effort": "high",
  "thinking": { "type": "enabled" }
}
```

## 可行方案对比

| 方案 | thinking 是否生效 |
|------|-------------------|
| `spring-ai-starter-model-openai` + `base-url: https://api.deepseek.com` + `OpenAiChatOptions.extraBody` | ✅ |
| `spring-ai-starter-model-deepseek` + `OpenAiChatOptions` | ❌ 参数被丢弃 |
| `spring-ai-starter-model-deepseek` + 模型 `deepseek-reasoner` | ✅ 另一套 API（`reasoning_content`，不是 v4-pro 的 `extra_body.thinking`） |

## 若坚持用 DeepSeek starter

**`deepseek-v4-pro` + thinking**：需要 OpenAI 兼容客户端（`spring-ai-starter-model-openai`），例如：

```java
.options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
    .reasoningEffort("high")
    .extraBody(Map.of("thinking", Map.of("type", "enabled")))
    .build())
```

**`deepseek-reasoner`**：用原生 DeepSeek 选项即可：

```java
.options(DeepSeekChatOptions.builder()
    .model("deepseek-reasoner")
    .build())
```

## 关于同时引入两个 starter

`pom.xml` 里若同时有 `openai` 和 `deepseek` starter，可能出现多个 `ChatModel` / `ChatClient.Builder` Bean，需要 `@Qualifier` 或 `@Primary` 明确注入哪一个；**仅加 `OpenAiChatOptions` 不会让 DeepSeek 的 `ChatModel` 带上 `extra_body`**。

---

**结论**：`deepseek-v4-pro` 的 thinking 模式应使用 **`spring-ai-starter-model-openai`（指向 DeepSeek API）+ `OpenAiChatOptions`**；DeepSeek starter 目前无法通过 `OpenAiChatOptions.extraBody` 传递 `thinking` 参数。若需要，我可以帮你把配置改回单一 starter 并理顺 Bean 注入。

_**Agent (composer-2.5)**_

双 starter 并存时，**不要**给 `ChatClient.Builder` 加 `@Qualifier`（也没有 `openAiChatClientBuilder` 这类稳定 Bean 名）。Spring AI 官方做法是：**关掉自动 `ChatClient.Builder`，按 `ChatModel` 类型分别建 `ChatClient`**。

## 正确写法

```34:45:d:\wudgaby\workspace\RuoYi-Vue-Plus\ruoyi-modules\ai-structured\src\main\java\com\wudgaby\ticket\config\AiClientConfig.java
    /**
     * 原生 DeepSeek API（如 deepseek-reasoner），走 DeepSeekChatModel。
     * 注意：此 Client 上设置 OpenAiChatOptions.extraBody 无效。
     */
    @Bean
    ChatClient deepseekChatClient(DeepSeekChatModel deepSeekChatModel) {
        return ChatClient.builder(deepSeekChatModel).build();
    }
```

`structuredOutputChatClient` 同理，注入 **`OpenAiChatModel`**（thinking + `extra_body` 只有这条链路有效）：

```java
@Bean
ChatClient structuredOutputChatClient(OpenAiChatModel openAiChatModel) {
    return ChatClient.builder(openAiChatModel)
        .defaultOptions(THINKING_OPTIONS)
        .defaultAdvisors(AdvisorParams.ENABLE_NATIVE_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT)
        .build();
}
```

## 必须配合的 `application.yml`

```yaml
spring:
  ai:
    chat:
      client:
        enabled: false   # 禁用单一 ChatClient.Builder，避免多 Model 冲突
```

否则容器里只有一个（或不确定的）`ChatClient.Builder`，`@Qualifier("")` 无法区分 OpenAI / DeepSeek。

## 注入时用 Bean 方法名

| Bean 方法名 | 底层 Model | 用途 |
|------------|------------|------|
| `structuredOutputChatClient` | `OpenAiChatModel` → DeepSeek API | `deepseek-v4-pro` + thinking + 结构化输出 |
| `deepseekChatClient` | `DeepSeekChatModel` | 原生 API，如 `deepseek-reasoner` |

```java
public MyService(@Qualifier("structuredOutputChatClient") ChatClient chatClient) { ... }
// 或按参数名注入（与 @Bean 方法名一致）
public MyService(ChatClient structuredOutputChatClient) { ... }
```

## 常见误区

1. **`@Qualifier` 不能用在 `ChatClient.Builder` 上** — 双 starter 下通常没有两个带名字的 Builder。
2. **`org.mapstruct.Qualifier` 写错了** — 应使用 `org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Qualifier`（若按 Bean 名注入）；本方案按 **方法参数类型** 注入，一般不需要 `@Qualifier`。
3. **`deepseekChatClient` + `OpenAiChatOptions`** — `DeepSeekChatModel` 会丢弃 `extraBody` / `reasoningEffort`；thinking 请用 `structuredOutputChatClient`（`OpenAiChatModel`）。

`TicketDecisionClient` 已从 `ChatClient.Builder` 改为注入 `structuredOutputChatClient`，避免 `chat.client.enabled=false` 后启动失败。

_**Agent (composer-2.5)**_

这是 **Docker 引擎未启动** 的问题，不是 `kafka-ui` 镜像或 compose 文件本身的问题。

## 原因

错误里的：

```text
open //./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine: The system cannot find the file specified
```

表示：Docker CLI 已安装，但 **Docker Desktop 的 Linux 引擎没在跑**，所以连不上守护进程，自然也拉不了 `provectuslabs/kafka-ui:latest`。

当前环境检测结果：`docker version` 只有 Client，没有 Server。

## 处理步骤

1. **启动 Docker Desktop**  
   开始菜单打开 “Docker Desktop”，等到托盘图标稳定，状态为 **Running**（不要停在 Starting）。

2. **确认引擎可用**：
   ```powershell
   docker version
   ```
   应同时看到 **Client** 和 **Server** 两段信息。

3. **再执行 compose**（建议在 compose 所在目录）：
   ```powershell
   cd d:\wudgaby\workspace\RuoYi-Vue-Plus\script\docker
   docker compose -f docker-compose-kafka.yml up -d
   ```

4. 若仍失败，在 Docker Desktop 里检查：
   - **Settings → General**：已启用引擎
   - **Settings → Resources**：WSL 2 集成正常（若用 WSL2 后端）
   - 必要时 **Restart Docker Desktop** 或 **Troubleshoot → Restart**

## 启动成功后

- Kafka：`localhost:9092`（与 `application.yml` 里 `KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS` 一致）
- Kafka UI：http://localhost:8080  

注意：你的 `ai-structured` 服务默认也是 **8080**，若同时跑会端口冲突，需要改其中一个端口（例如把 kafka-ui 改成 `8081:8080`）。

---

**总结**：先让 Docker Desktop 跑起来，再执行 `docker compose`；当前报错与 Kafka 配置无关，是 Windows 上 Docker 守护进程未连接。

_**Agent (composer-2.5)**_

这是**正常现象**，不影响业务接口。

## 原因

访问 `http://localhost:8080/...` 时，浏览器会**自动**再请求 `/favicon.ico`。  
`ai-structured` 是纯 API 服务，没有 `static/favicon.ico`，Spring MVC 6 会抛出 `NoResourceFoundException`，被若依的 `GlobalExceptionHandler` 里 `ServletException` 处理器当成「未知异常」打成 **ERROR**。

## 处理

已增加 `FaviconController`，对 `/favicon.ico` 返回 **204 No Content**，不再走静态资源查找，也不会再打 ERROR 日志。

重启应用后，用浏览器访问一次，日志里不应再出现这条 favicon 异常。

## 其他说明

- 若只想消除日志、不改代码：在浏览器里忽略即可，或不要从浏览器地址栏直接打开 API 根路径。
- 若需要真实图标：可在 `src/main/resources/static/` 下放 `favicon.ico`，并删除该 Controller。
